title: University of California, Irvine
description: UC Irvine's official brand colour palette defines the primary colours UCI Blue (#255799) and UCI Gold (#FECC07), and the secondary colours Darkest Blue (#002244), Dark Blue (#1B3D6D), Teal Blue (#0083B3), Turquoise (#00B0CA), Orange (#F78D2D), Gold (#F0AB00), Dark Gray (#555759) and Light Gray (#C6BEB5).
